title: Biyo-xidheenkii Jabiyay Boqortooyada
intro: Dhul ay ka buuxaan webiyo socda, laba beerood oo cagaar ah, iyo barwaaqo aan la barbar dhigi karin - laakiin dadkii degganaa way ka digtoonaadeen kii barakeeyey. Markii xasuusintu soo noqotay, way ka jeesteen. Waxa xigay ciqaab weli u eg digniin. Yaa ahaa bulshadan qadiimiga ah?
clues: Waxaan ku noolayn dhul aad u barakeysan oo gurigeennu ku yaalay laba beerood oo cagaar ah.
Waxaan ku raaxaysanay webiyada oo dhex mara dhulkeenna iyo goosashada badan ee guryaheenna buuxisay.
Haddana markii naloogu yeeray mahadnaq iyo addeecid Rabbigeen, waan iska jeesannay annagoo kibirsan.
Hantideenna iyo raaxadayadu waxay naga dhigeen inaan illowno Kii wax walba siiyay.
Dabadeed waxaa yimid daad degdeg ah oo ka soo gudbay caqabaddii weynayd ee aan ku tiirsanayn.
Waxaan nahay dadka Saba', oo dhulkooda loo yaqaanay Biyo-xireenka weyn ee Ma'rib.

trial.label: Hoos u dhaceenna
options: Dabaylo xoog leh oo cirka ka timid

outcome.label: Qaddarkeenna
options: Laba beerood oo qadhaadh ayaa beddelay kuwii naga wanaagsanaa
Dhulku wuxuu ku degay badda hoosteeda
Qarankeennu wuxuu u qaybsamay laba iyo toban qabiil
outcome.answer: Laba beerood oo qadhaadh ayaa beddelay kuwii naga wanaagsanaa

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
